templates.name: Lead Follow-Up Email Sequence
templates.description: Automatically sends a timed follow-up email when a new lead is captured in your CRM, keeping prospects warm without manual outreach.
templates.estimatedROI: Recovers 15–25% of leads that would otherwise go cold within 48 hours

templates.name: Appointment Reminder SMS
templates.description: Sends SMS reminders 24 hours and 2 hours before scheduled appointments, reducing no-shows and last-minute cancellations.
templates.estimatedROI: Reduces no-show rates by 20–35% for appointment-based businesses

templates.name: Post-Service Review Request
templates.description: Triggers a review request email or SMS after a completed service or transaction, routing happy clients to Google or Yelp.
templates.estimatedROI: Generates 3–5 new reviews per month with zero staff effort

templates.name: New Client Onboarding
templates.description: Kicks off a multi-step onboarding sequence when a deal closes or a new patient signs up — welcome email, intake forms, and internal team notification.
templates.estimatedROI: Cuts onboarding admin time by 2–4 hours per new client

templates.name: Invoice Follow-Up
templates.description: Monitors overdue invoices and sends escalating reminder emails at 7, 14, and 30 days past due.
templates.estimatedROI: Accelerates payment collection by an average of 8–12 days

templates.name: Monthly Performance Report
templates.description: Pulls KPI data from your CRM and email platform, compiles a summary, and emails it to stakeholders on the first of each month.
templates.estimatedROI: Saves 3–5 hours of manual reporting per month

templates.name: Social Content Publish
templates.description: Publishes approved content from a Google Sheet or Airtable to LinkedIn and Facebook on a scheduled cadence.
templates.estimatedROI: Maintains consistent social presence without a dedicated marketing hire

templates.name: AI Chatbot Escalation
templates.description: Routes website chatbot conversations to a human team member via Slack or email when the AI detects high intent or frustration.
templates.estimatedROI: Captures 10–20% more qualified leads from website visitors
